collection.method: Thirteen 2h created-time windows below GitHub's 1,000-result cap; jobs (all attempts) for core workflows only; 123 open PR heads' latest check runs; stock evidence.sh recipes executed as supporting data

clock_limits: GitHub job clocks resolve one second; cross-host skew uncalibrated
BuildBuddy target-history startTime/duration repeat exactly for cache hits; fresh executions are first appearances of a (duration,status) pair
No webhook/inbox/agent-receipt clock was measured this run

pr_heads.unknown_class_note: 115 heads returned no PR from commits/{sha}/pulls: force-pushed-away superseded heads and fork synthetic sources; kept in the population, class 'unknown'

job_metrics.name:
github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
    github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository &&
    'Fork Nix check runs in trusted-fork-pr-ci' ||
    'Build artifacts + imports check'

github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository &&
    'Build artifacts + imports check' ||
    'Fork Nix check not applicable'

occupancy.scope: Completed positive-runner intervals of core workflows clipped to the window; lower bound, not account utilization.

cold_executor_outlier.note: node Ready 27s vs 10s; every fixture image import 5-10x slower (virt-launcher 38.3s, vm-guest-root 46.5s vs 0.4/0.7s); VM boots 91-93s vs 67-75s; served as cache hit to 7 later devel invocations

regression_12793_mtls.cert_manager_issuance: per-sandbox Certificate Issuing->Ready in <=0.3s (cert-manager.log, ef2c9e9f); issuance is not the added time

browser_review.tool: google-chrome headless (local) with cdnjs assets reachable; screenshots at 1280 and 390 px; Chart.js initialised every canvas; headroom calculator output matches the static table; zero console errors; markup balanced
browser_review.limit: screenshots were not eyeballed by the author in this session

validation.stock_recipes: devinfra/ci/skills/ci_latency/scripts/evidence.sh executed on the merged snapshot (collect/merged/evidence_stock.json, local)

presentation.note: pinned cdnjs assets; the page degrades to plain HTML offline and the headroom calculator uses the embedded green-head rows
